title: Master Chronology — September 9-12, 2025 (5-minute resolution)
intro: Charlie Kirk Master Chronology — September 9–12, 2025 (5-minute grid, MDT) One row per 5-minute interval. Exact seconds/minutes are preserved in 'Exact / Reported Time'. A blank event row is a gap in the currently established timestamped record, not proof that nothing occurred.

events.actors: KSL / Deseret News; Charlie Kirk / TPUSA
events.event: KSL publishes a preview stating Kirk's American Comeback Tour stop at Utah Valley University is scheduled for noon on Sep. 10.
events.notes: Establishes that the event time/location was publicly advertised before the shooting.

events.actors: Tyler Robinson; Lance Twiggs
events.event: Twiggs later says Robinson left the apartment very early, probably closer to 4:00 a.m., saying he had a long drive to work.
events.evidence_basis: Recorded witness interview admitted at preliminary hearing
events.notes: Time is an estimate, not a device or surveillance timestamp.

events.actors: Person investigators identify as Tyler Robinson
events.event: A gray Dodge Challenger associated with Robinson arrives on campus; surveillance later used by investigators to identify the driver as Robinson.
events.notes: Day-2 testimony describes arrival at approximately 8:30 a.m.; public timeline gives 8:29 a.m.

events.exact_time: After 8:29 AM; exact minute not stated
events.actors: Person investigators identify as Tyler Robinson; unidentified TPUSA representatives
events.event: Surveillance testimony says the individual walks toward the event area and makes contact with unidentified TPUSA representatives.
events.notes: Placed in the first available 5-minute slot after arrival; the contact itself was not given an exact clock time.

events.actors: Person investigators identify as Tyler Robinson
events.event: The individual returns to the vehicle after the first campus visit; the vehicle then leaves campus.
events.notes: Approximate time from preliminary-hearing testimony.

events.actors: Person investigators identify as Tyler Robinson
events.event: The same individual returns to campus on foot wearing the same general clothing and carrying a blue backpack.
events.notes: Exact minute was not stated; 10:05 is used only as the 5-minute bucket for 'just after 10:00'.

events.exact_time: Between just after 10:00 AM and just before 11:00 AM
events.actors: Person investigators identify as Tyler Robinson
events.location: Sorensen Center / Chick-fil-A; wooded area; Gunther / CS building; Losee roof access area
events.event: Surveillance testimony describes the individual eating at Chick-fil-A, moving into a wooded area, later reappearing without the backpack, traversing campus buildings, and testing/accessing a route toward the Losee roof before leaving.
events.notes: This is a windowed sequence, not an exact 10:10 event. It is anchored here to avoid inventing intermediate minute-by-minute times.

events.actors: Person investigators identify as Tyler Robinson
events.event: The second pre-shooting campus visit ends; surveillance testimony says the individual walks off campus.
events.notes: Approximate boundary from testimony.

events.actors: Suspected shooter / person prosecutors identify as Tyler Robinson
events.event: School surveillance captures the suspected shooter walking onto campus for the shooting visit, according to the charging-document timeline reported by AP.
events.notes: Preliminary-hearing testimony independently describes a third visit in different clothing.

events.actors: Charlie Kirk; TPUSA; attendees; security detail
events.event: Kirk's outdoor 'Prove Me Wrong' / American Comeback Tour event begins.

events.actors: Person investigators identify as Tyler Robinson
events.event: Surveillance testimony places the individual at the exterior stair/railing accessing the Losee roof and rolling over the railing onto the roof.
events.notes: Approximate time in preliminary-hearing testimony.

events.actors:

events.location:

• UVU event area

• UVU radio / event scene
• Near Campus Drive / UVU
events.event:
• A single shot is fired and Kirk is struck. Preliminary-hearing surveillance testimony gives the shot time as 12:23:28 p.m.
• Harpole later recounts jumping down to cover Kirk and beginning pressure control within about five seconds.
• Harpole later says the security team began moving Kirk toward the vehicle within roughly 15 seconds of the shot.
• A UVU officer radios that shots were fired and Charlie Kirk is down; subsequent radio traffic says he is being taken toward the hospital.
• Surveillance testimony timestamps the fleeing individual approaching Campus Drive after jumping from the roof.

• Law enforcement / dispatch
• Suspect escape
events.evidence_basis:

• Later direct witness account
• Later direct witness account
• Dispatch recording summarized by AP
• Sworn surveillance testimony
events.confidence:

events.notes:
• The 5-minute bucket begins at 12:20; the exact second is preserved here.
• Relative timing is from Harpole's later recollection, not a synchronized surveillance timestamp.
• Do not read this as an exact vehicle-departure time.
• Testimony says the individual then crosses Campus Drive and enters the wooded area.

events.actors: George Zinn; UVU Police
events.event: George Zinn falsely claims he shot Kirk and is detained. Authorities later state he had no tie to the shooting.
events.notes: No precise minute is provided in the official statement; 12:30 is an approximate post-shooting bucket.

events.actors: FBI; local police
events.event: First FBI agents arrive on scene, 16 minutes after the shooting, according to FBI Director Patel.

events.actors: Utah Valley University
events.event: UVU issues an alert saying a single shot was fired and stating that a suspect was in custody.
events.evidence_basis: Contemporaneous alert timeline reported by AP
events.notes: This early 'suspect in custody' message was later contradicted by law-enforcement updates that the shooter remained at large.

events.actors: Orem Police Department
events.event: Orem Police states the shooting suspect is not in custody and remains at large.
events.notes: Directly conflicts with the earlier UVU alert's custody wording.

events.actors: President Donald Trump; Charlie Kirk
events.event: Trump publicly announces that Kirk has died from his injuries.
events.notes: This is the public announcement time, not necessarily the hospital's exact time of death.

events.actors: Orem Mayor David Young / local officials
events.event: Orem's mayor says the suspected shooter remains at large.

events.actors: FBI Director Kash Patel
events.event: Patel posts that 'the subject' in the shooting is in custody.
events.notes: This did not refer to Tyler Robinson; the person was later released. The wording caused widespread confusion.

events.actors: Utah state/local officials
events.event: Officials characterize the detained person as a person of interest while emphasizing the investigation/manhunt is continuing.
events.notes: The precise press-conference minute varies across contemporaneous reports.

events.actors: FBI Director Kash Patel
events.event: Patel announces the person in custody has been released after interrogation; the investigation continues.
events.notes: A later report timestamps Patel's follow-up at 7:59 p.m. ET / 5:59 p.m. MDT.

events.actors: Charlie Kirk's remains; motorcade
events.event: WIRED's reporter observes a motorcade carrying Kirk's body leave the hospital.
events.notes: Approximate eyewitness time.

events.actors:
• Tyler Robinson; Lance Twiggs
• Lance Twiggs
events.event:
• According to a Cellebrite extraction described at the preliminary hearing, the first direct text in the relevant Robinson–Twiggs exchange is sent at 11:00 p.m.; Twiggs is told to look under Robinson's keyboard.
• Twiggs says he finds and photographs a handwritten note under Robinson's computer keyboard after receiving the 11:00 p.m. message.
events.evidence_basis:
• Cellebrite extraction + sworn testimony
• Recorded witness interview + sworn testimony
events.notes:
• This is a key anchor: the direct text chain begins on Sep. 10, well before Robinson's Sep. 11 surrender.
• The note's authenticity and meaning remain matters for the criminal proceeding; this row records the testified discovery chronology.

events.actors: Person officer believed was Tyler Robinson; vehicle registered to Tyler/Amber Robinson
events.location: Campus Drive / 800 South area near UVU
events.event: Preliminary-hearing testimony describes an officer interaction with a vehicle tied to Robinson; the officer later said the male he interacted with was believed to be Tyler Robinson.
events.evidence_basis: Sworn testimony based on officer report/video
events.notes: Important because the timestamp is after midnight Sep. 11, not immediately after the 12:23 p.m. shooting.

events.actors: FBI
events.event: At Patel's direction, the FBI releases its first set of suspect photographs.

events.actors: FBI
events.event: FBI announces a reward of up to $100,000 for information leading to identification/arrest.

events.actors: Vice President JD Vance; Usha Vance; Air Force Two
events.location: Roland R. Wright Air Base, Salt Lake City
events.event: Air Force Two lands in Salt Lake City; Vance later meets privately with Kirk's family.

events.actors: Charlie Kirk's casket; JD Vance; Air Force Two
events.event: Air Force Two departs Salt Lake City with Kirk's casket aboard for Arizona.

events.actors: FBI Director Kash Patel; Deputy Director Dan Bongino
events.event: Patel says he and Bongino arrive on scene.

events.actors: FBI
events.event: FBI releases four additional photographs of the person of interest.

events.actors: Tyler Robinson; Lance Twiggs
events.event: Agent Davis recalls the last relevant direct text from Robinson to Twiggs as about 7:42 p.m.; in the displayed sequence Robinson says he is going to turn himself in willingly and hopes to keep it quiet.
events.evidence_basis: Cellebrite extraction described in sworn testimony
events.notes: Agent Davis explicitly corrected the date to Sep. 11.

events.actors: Tyler Robinson; Discord friend group
events.event: Agent Davis testifies that the first Robinson message visible in State's Exhibit 16.2 was sent at 7:57 p.m. Sep. 11; the messages were also recovered through a Discord subpoena.
events.notes: This is before the ~9:00 p.m. sheriff-office arrival and before the FBI's 10:00 p.m. custody milestone.

events.actors:
• FBI / Utah officials
• Washington County Sheriff Nate Brooksby; retired detective/family friend
events.location:
• Press conference / public release
• Washington County, Utah
events.event:
• Officials release surveillance video of the fleeing suspect; the FBI release log timestamps the video at 10:00 p.m. Eastern, i.e. 8:00 p.m. Mountain.
• Brooksby receives a call saying the family knows the shooter's identity and is trying to convince him to surrender voluntarily.
events.evidence_basis:
• Official FBI release log
• Sheriff account summarized by AP
events.notes: Patel's Sep. 12 remarks also describe the governor-led press conference as approximately 8 p.m.

events.actors: Tyler Robinson; parents; Washington County Sheriff's Office
events.event: Agent Davis testifies, based on police reports/video, that Robinson arrived at the sheriff's office at approximately 9:00 p.m.; AP likewise reports a roughly 9 p.m. voluntary surrender.
events.notes: This is an arrival/surrender milestone, distinct from the FBI's later 10:00 p.m. 'taken into custody' time.

events.actors: Tyler Robinson; law enforcement
events.event: FBI Director Patel states the suspect was 'taken into custody' at 10:00 p.m. local time.
events.notes: Potentially a formal-custody milestone after the ~9:00 p.m. voluntary arrival; the sources do not establish that the two timestamps describe the identical procedural act.

events.actors: Utah/FBI officials; Tyler Robinson
events.event: Authorities publicly announce Robinson is in custody; AP's timeline states he is booked into Utah County Jail.
events.notes: Do not confuse this public announcement/book-in milestone with the Sep. 11 evening surrender and custody milestones.

events.actors: Law enforcement / prosecutors; Tyler Robinson
events.event: A probable-cause statement publicly outlines evidence and the state felony allegations against Robinson.
events.notes: At this stage these are allegations, not adjudicated findings.

unslotted.event: Twiggs says he saw Robinson at the apartment after waking; he describes an in-person exchange and says Robinson eventually indicated he would speak with his parents or turn himself over.

unslotted.evidence_basis: Recorded witness interview admitted at hearing

methodology.Implementation: All master-grid times are Mountain Daylight Time (MDT), UTC−06:00, unless a source originally used ET and the converted MDT time is explicitly shown.
Each event is placed in the 5-minute interval containing its exact/estimated time. Example: 12:23:28 appears in the 12:20 slot while retaining 12:23:28 in the exact-time field.
When a source says 'just after 10', 'morning', or gives a broad window, the workbook says so. It does not manufacture exact intermediate minutes.
GAP means no timestamped event is currently placed in that interval. It does not mean nothing happened.

Statements attributed to Robinson, forensic claims, and charging-document assertions are described as testimony/allegations where appropriate; the workbook does not treat unresolved criminal allegations as adjudicated facts.
Conflicting public statements are preserved. Examples: the early UVU 'suspect in custody' alert vs. later at-large statements; ~9 p.m. sheriff-office arrival vs. FBI's 10 p.m. custody milestone.

The hearing record anchors the relevant direct SMS chain at 11:00 p.m. Sep. 10, the last relevant direct text around 7:42 p.m. Sep. 11, and the first Robinson Discord message in Exhibit 16.2 at 7:57 p.m. Sep. 11.

Prior Trends anomalies are not placed into the strict 5-minute chronology without a primary authenticated timestamp. The prior audit found no Grade-A/publicly authenticated case-specific Google export proving foreknowledge.
This version covers Sep. 9 00:00 through Sep. 12 23:55 inclusive. It focuses on publicly documented case-relevant events and the suspect/investigation chronology.
